title: Criteria attack record
description: Record of one attack round over a document's acceptance criteria: the revision attacked, which lenses reported, what they proposed, and how each proposal was adjudicated.

spec_path.description: The attacked document, which this record is committed beside.

spec_revision.description: Revision of the document this round attacked.

lenses.description: One entry per lens that reported, empty reports included. A lens that errored or returned unreadable output has no entry, and the round is unfinished.

proposals.description: The union of the lens reports. A proposal's position is the stable index its disposition names.

revision.description: Content-addressed revision of the document: sha256: followed by the hex digest of its bytes, or the 40-hex object id of the same content.

lens.description: The attack lens that produced this proposal.

target_ac.description: Identifier of the criterion attacked, or "none" when no criterion covers the ground at all.

hole.description: What the criteria as written let through.

proposed_ac.description: The criterion proposed to close the hole, stated as an observable claim.

red_test_sketch.description: The failing test the proposed criterion makes writable. All three parts are required and non-blank: an item that cannot name a starting state, an action, and an observable outcome is a concern rather than a testable claim, and is not a proposal.

index.description: Position of the proposal this adjudicates.

rationale.description: Why. Required and non-blank on a rejection.

revision.description: Revision of the document that carries an accepted proposal. Required on an acceptance, and different from the revision attacked.

covering_ac.description: Identifier of the criterion in that revision which carries it. Required on an acceptance.
